properties.description: Every HTTP surface's /readyz answer keeps its status and first line, and adds a second line 'open files: N of L allowed (R left)' and two headers, x-reflow2-open-files and x-reflow2-open-file-limit, for a monitor to alarm on. N is counted from /proc/self/fd on Linux; elsewhere it reads 'unknown', never a guess. L is the soft RLIMIT_NOFILE ('unlimited' or 'unknown' where there is none). Additive: no field removed or renamed. Code: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/readiness.rs (ready_answer) and file_handles.rs (open_file_count, headroom_line).
properties.name: GET /readyz reports the files the server has open against its open-file limit
